runtimes.value: Ollama official qwen3-coder-next (tool-call parser rejects some long file writes, #18563 open); llama.cpp llama-server with GGUF (ggml-org); LM Studio (lmstudio-community GGUF and MLX 4/6/8-bit); mlx-lm with mlx-community builds (4-8 bit, bf16, mxfp4/8, nvfp4); vllm-mlx has qwen3_next MTP patch and Qwen3 parsers
runtimes.note: Ollama issue status from an earlier check (13.11.2026), not re-checked. vllm-mlx support inferred from its patch modules.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, Ollama, llama.cpp and mlx-lm issues. **Reddit could not be read** (blocked for automated reading); summaries of Reddit threads by other sites were not used as evidence. Released 30.01.2026; window: since 13.05.2026 plus the launch discussion.
web.summary: Fast, but overtaken by Qwen3.8-27B; no successor in the coder line. Weak case for downloading it.
web.verdict: Fast but overtaken by Qwen3.8-27B; **LICENSE file missing**

comments.text: **Licence**: the card says Apache 2.0, but the LICENSE file is missing (404), also in the GGUF repository ([HF #52, 18.07.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next/discussions/52); [HF #29, 11.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next/discussions/29)).

Coder and Coder-Next seen as obsolete, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B recommended instead ([seanmcdirmid, 21.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50183994)); not as good as Qwen3.6-27B, though faster ([UncleOxidant, 08.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48834700)).

No thinking mode, so it has to go over its work several times ([Tade0, 03.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50350667)); ignores simple instructions ([HF #50, 18.06.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next/discussions/50)).
Ollama's tool-call parser rejects some long file writes ([ollama#18563, open](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/18563)).
The best results so far for one user ([Shorel, 13.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48520417)).
